channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: India Blocks 242 Illegal Betting Websites Under Online Gaming Act, Nearly 8,000 Platforms Taken Down: Reports
item.description: India blocks 242 illegal betting sites, reaching 7,800 total takedowns to protect youth from financial risks.

item.title: “Beautiful Girl Can Distract a Man”: How Congress MLA Phool Singh Baraiya’s Remarks Normalised Victim-Blaming and Sparked Uproar
item.description: A Congress legislator’s remarks blaming rape on beauty, caste and scriptures have drawn sharp political backlash and social condemnation.

item.title: From Street Sympathy to Hidden Wealth: Indore’s Beggar-Free Drive Exposes a Crorepati Behind a Familiar Disabled Beggar Image
item.description: A physically disabled man long perceived as destitute was found owning multiple properties during Indore’s anti-begging campaign.

item.title: Haryana Horror: 42-Year-Old Woman Gangraped Near Metro Station in Bahadurgarh, CCTV and UPI Trail Lead to Swift Arrests
item.description: A late-night assault near a Delhi-NCR metro station exposes gaps in women’s safety while highlighting the power of digital evidence in securing swift justice.

item.title: Uttar Pradesh: Two Builders Booked, Noida Authority Official Sacked After 27-Year-Old Engineer Drowns in Open Construction Pit
item.description: A young software engineer’s fatal fall into an unsecured construction pit has exposed serious safety lapses by developers and civic authorities in Noida.

item.title: DGCA Fines IndiGo ₹22.20 Crore After December Operational Meltdown, Issues Warnings To Senior Management
item.description: DGCA slaps ₹22.20 crore fine on IndiGo and warns top leadership over massive December 2025 flight disruptions.

item.title: ₹100 Crore Defamation Suit: Suvendu Adhikari Drags Mamata Banerjee to Court Over Coal Scam Allegations
item.description: The Bengal opposition leader says the chief minister’s unsubstantiated allegations forced him to seek legal redress.

item.title: Wedding Journey Turns Fatal in Jharkhand: 7 Killed, Over 80 Injured as Bus Overturns in Latehar, Probe On
item.description: A bus carrying wedding guests overturned in Jharkhand’s Latehar district, killing seven people and injuring over 80, prompting questions on road safety and vehicle fitness in hilly regions.

item.title: Rajasthan Horror: Teen Allegedly Kidnapped By Girlfriend’s Family, Beaten For Days, Forced To Drink Urine
item.description: Rajasthan: teen allegedly kidnapped by girlfriend's family, forced to drink urine during three-day alleged torture.

item.title: J&K: Eight Indian Army Soldiers Injured In Gunfight With JeM Terrorists During Operation Trashi-I In Kishtwar
item.description: Eight soldiers sustained injuries during a fierce encounter with hiding terrorists in Kishtwar’s dense Sonnar forest.
